description: A modular risk-adaptive SDLC workflow with atomic gate reviews and verification, scoped change control, and recoverable state.

interface.shortDescription: Risk-adaptive product, engineering, and testing workflow.
interface.longDescription: Run a formal software delivery workflow in any project without copying project files. The orchestrator performs evidence-backed requirement and risk triage, selects the lowest safe micro, quick, standard, or strict flow, locks user-confirmed core outcomes, atomically records complete role-gate reviews and strict verification bundles, supports user-approved impact-scoped change control with conservative fallback, requires profile-appropriate semantic final-user-journey checks, binds distinct role task references into gate snapshots, requires final user delivery approval in every mode, and preserves recoverable checksummed state, human authorization checkpoints, and structured meeting records.
